1: # Implementation Plan — Real GEE Image Export to Google Drive & End-to-End Baseline Activation
2: 
3: Fix the critical bug where real Google Earth Engine (GEE) satellite discovery succeeded for Sentinel-2 scene `COPERNICUS/S2_SR_HARMONIZED/20200109T051201_20200109T051844_T43PHM`, but the image export pipeline was never initiated, leaving Google Drive empty and preventing GeoTIFF validation, spectral index computation, and genuine baseline activation.
4: 
5: ## User Review Required
6: 
7: > [!IMPORTANT]
8: > **Google Drive Authentication Scope with ADC**
9: > During research, we successfully executed a live test against the Google Earth Engine REST API (`v1alpha/projects/monitoring-system-506515/image:export`). The export was accepted with **HTTP 200 OK**, executed by Earth Engine, and SUCCEEDED (`state: "SUCCEEDED"`), uploading the GeoTIFF to Google Drive folder `1vo_f6_ClenADeoRxkehbDO8hbEKCK9XC`.
10: > 
11: > However, when our Node.js backend attempts to search or download files from Google Drive via `drive.googleapis.com`, the API returns `ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT (403)` because the current Application Default Credentials (ADC) for account `jeyaseelan2348@gmail.com` only possess Google Cloud Platform scopes (`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform`), but not Google Drive scopes (`https://www.googleapis.com/auth/drive`).
12: > 
13: > To enable automated file download from Google Drive, one of two things is required:
14: > 1. The user runs:
15: >    ```bash
16: >    gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access --update-adc
17: >    ```
18: >    which prompts in the browser to approve Google Drive access for ADC.
19: > 2. OR, if the user has not yet granted Drive scopes to ADC, the pipeline will detect this and set:
20: >    - `status: DRIVE_FILE_MISSING`
21: >    - `failureReason: "DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED: Request had insufficient authentication scopes. Please authenticate via 'gcloud auth login --enable-gdrive-access --update-adc'."`
22: > 
23: > We will ensure the pipeline handles both cases gracefully and never fakes Drive file metadata.
24: 
25: > [!WARNING]
26: > **Sentinel-2 Export Band Data Types**
27: > Sentinel-2 L2A optical bands (B1–B12) are `UInt16`, while scene classification `SCL` and QA bands are `Byte` (UInt8). Earth Engine rejects exporting mixed `UInt16` and `Byte` bands into a single GeoTIFF (`Exported bands must have compatible data types; found inconsistent types: UInt16 and Byte`).
28: > In our live test, exporting the optical bands `['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8', 'B11', 'B12']` succeeded completely. The export selection will export these compatible bands for optical processing (NDVI, NDWI, NDBI).
29:

32: ## Proposed Changes
33: 
34: ### GEE Export & Polling Layer
35: 
36: #### [MODIFY] [GeeExportService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/gee/GeeExportService.ts)
37: - Replace outdated REST endpoint and payload with the verified Earth Engine REST API `v1alpha/projects/${projectId}/image:export` specification.
38: - Build the DAG Expression:
39:   - Node `raw_image`: `Image.load` with `id: scene.imageId`
40:   - Node `selected_bands`: `Image.select` with compatible bands (`['B2', 'B3', 'B4', 'B8', 'B11', 'B12']` for Sentinel-2, `['SR_B2', 'SR_B3', 'SR_B4', 'SR_B5', 'SR_B6', 'SR_B7']` for Landsat, `['VV', 'VH']` for SAR)
41:   - Node `geom`: `GeometryConstructors.Polygon` with zone coordinates
42:   - Node `clipped`: `Image.clip` with `input: selected_bands`, `geometry: geom`
43:   - Result: `'clipped'`
44: - Set `fileExportOptions` to `GEO_TIFF`, `driveDestination` (`folder: config.driveFolderId`, `filenamePrefix`), `geoTiffOptions: { cloudOptimized: true }`.
45: - Send `Authorization: Bearer ${token}` and `X-Goog-User-Project: ${projectId}` headers.
46: - Extract actual operation/task ID `data.name` (e.g., `projects/monitoring-system-506515/operations/...`).
47: - Remove all fake/generated fallback task IDs (`GEE-TASK-...`). Throw `AppError` on any failure.
48: 
49: #### [MODIFY] [GeeTaskService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/gee/GeeTaskService.ts)
50: - Update polling to query `https://earthengine.googleapis.com/v1alpha/${taskId}` with `X-Goog-User-Project: ${projectId}`.
51: - Map operation states accurately:
52:   - `data.done === true && data.metadata?.state === 'SUCCEEDED'` -> `EXPORT_COMPLETED`
53:   - `data.done === true && (data.error || data.metadata?.state === 'FAILED')` -> `EXPORT_FAILED` with real error message
54:   - `data.metadata?.state === 'RUNNING'` / `'READY'` -> `EXPORT_RUNNING`
55: - Remove all development fast-track mock completions.

59: ### Google Drive & Raster Validation Layer
60: 
61: #### [MODIFY] [GoogleDriveService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/drive/GoogleDriveService.ts)
62: - Remove `mockFallbackGenerator` from `downloadGeoTiff()`.
63: - Add explicit error detection for `ACCESS_TOKEN_SCOPE_INSUFFICIENT` and surface `DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED`.
64: - In `findExportedFile()`, search by exact name and prefix, returning real Google Drive file metadata (`id`, `name`, `size`, `createdTime`).
65: - In `downloadGeoTiff()`, stream real file from Drive, verify non-zero size, and save to local storage path.
66: 
67: #### [MODIFY] [GeoTiffService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/raster/GeoTiffService.ts)
68: - Ensure extraction of actual raster dimensions (`width`, `height`), `numBands`, resolution, and CRS from parsed GeoTIFF.
69: - Provide a validation function `validateBaselineGeoTiff(localPath)` verifying dimensions > 0, band count >= required, CRS existence, and calculating real spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, NDBI).

73: ### Baseline Pipeline & Activation Layer
74: 
75: #### [MODIFY] [BaselineService.ts](file:///d:/tn-enforcement-system/tn-forest-monitoring/server/src/services/BaselineService.ts)
76: - Update `selectAndEvaluateCandidate()` to initiate the real export pipeline when a candidate is selected:
77:   - Create `Baseline` record in `EXPORT_REQUESTED` status.
78:   - Trigger `GeeExportService.requestImageExport()`.
79:   - Save `geeExportTaskId` and update status to `EXPORT_RUNNING`.
80:   - Trigger asynchronous pipeline runner (or execute synchronous wait if requested):
81:     - Poll GEE export task until completion.
82:     - Search Google Drive for exported file.
83:     - If Drive authentication fails, set status `DRIVE_FILE_MISSING` and failure reason `DRIVE_AUTH_FAILED: ...`.
84:     - If found, save `driveFileId`, `driveFileName`, `driveFileSizeBytes`, `driveFileCreatedAt`, update status to `DRIVE_AVAILABLE`.
85:     - Download GeoTIFF to `localRasterPath`.
86:     - Validate GeoTIFF metadata (`rasterValidated: true`, `rasterWidth`, `rasterHeight`, `rasterBandCount`, `rasterCrs`).
87:     - Calculate spectral indices (NDVI, NDWI, NDBI) and set `spectralIndicesCalculated: true`.
88:     - Set status to `PROCESSED`.
89: - In `activateBaseline()`:
90:   - Retain all 14 safety checks.
91:   - Baseline only activates if all checks pass.
92:   - Ensure baseline never auto-advances.
